_team_scope_note: PMN records the team in two different fields depending on issue type: cf[10040] 'Epic Team\s' is set on epics, cf[10098] 'Team Name' on stories/bugs/tasks (and some epics). Filtering on either one alone silently drops most of the data -- as of Aug 2026, cf[10040] matched 41 Ascenders issues and cf[10098] matched 680. any_clause is the union, used for epics and the all-issue-type AI series; bug_clause is what bugs actually carry.
_forecast_note: 26.4 closed at exactly 22 -- hit the target on the nose. History (0, 0, 1, 13, 22) still shows a ramp, decelerating (diffs +12, +9), so the trend continuation for 27.1 is ~28. Capped per Kobi's 2026-10-07 rule at 125% of 26.4's actual (22 * 1.25 = 27.5), so 27 is used instead of the uncapped 28. 2026-10-08 India-festival adjustment: the team reported 29 leaves last quarter vs 87 this quarter (+58 leave-days). Against an estimated ~19 core contributors (distinct people closing 3+ issues in the last 90 days) that is a 5.2% capacity loss on a like-for-like 60-weekday window (58 / (19*60 - 29)), so the capped 27 becomes 26 (25.6 rounded). If the 29/87 figures cover Ascenders and CXCO combined (~30 people) the loss is 3.3% and the target is still 26.
forecast_basis: capped trend (27), reduced 5.2% for India-festival leave (29 -> 87 days)
_recipients_note: Recipient addresses are NOT in this file -- the repo is public. They come from the ASCENDERS_DASHBOARD_RECIPIENTS secret (semicolon-separated); the test audience comes from PMN_DASHBOARD_TEST_RECIPIENT.
_edct_note: EDCT is computed from Jira changelogs by edct_from_jira.py, not copied from Power BI: average calendar days in In Progress/Validation, excluding flagged days and Maintenance-category epics. Validated against the R&D Efficiency KPI-TREND row for PMN Apr-Aug 2026 (7/24/26/23/7) - exact match on all five months. Set edct_count_done_day true to follow the written definition instead, which reads ~1 day higher.
